decision_log.decision: Fireplace on the west short wall, centred at y 2.25, as a full-height honed limestone chimney breast between two flush oak alcove units.
decision_log.rationale: Makes the hearth the terminus of the room's long axis so the whole entry sequence from the east reads toward the fire; flush alcoves turn the short wall into one composed plane.

decision_log.decision: Continuous window band on the south long wall, x 0.45-4.35 (3.90 m, 65%), sill 0.85 m, head 2.20 m.
decision_log.rationale: Exceeds the 60% minimum, floods the seating group with side light from the fire's flank rather than behind viewers' eyes, and the 0.85 m sill lets the two-seat sofa (0.80 m back) sit beneath it.

decision_log.decision: Entry door at the south end of the east wall (y 0.30-1.20), hinged south, opening into a 1.35 x 2.50 m vestibule.
decision_log.rationale: Places the door as far as possible from the fire and the seating; its centre is 1.84 m from the nearest seat footprint, exceeding the 1.50 m minimum.

decision_log.decision: Entry sequence built from three named elements: full-height slatted oak screen (F10), coat cupboard (F11) and a 2.20 m soffit over the vestibule.
decision_log.rationale: Compress-then-release: you arrive under a low ceiling beside a screen, turn north, and the room opens at full height with the fire ahead; the screen also backs the principal sofa so no seat faces the door directly.

decision_log.decision: Seating as a U of three pieces: 3-seat sofa facing the fire, 2-seat sofa under the window, leather armchair on the north side, 6 seats in total.
decision_log.rationale: Every seat sees the fire; three separate pieces let the group breathe in a 4.50 m wide room where two facing 3-seaters would leave no 0.90 m route.

decision_log.decision: North long wall kept free of furniture as a 1.10 m gallery corridor from the landing to the fireplace, lit by track wall-washers.
decision_log.rationale: In a 4.50 m wide room this is the only way to guarantee a 0.90 m clear route to the fireplace without cutting through the seating group; the bare wall becomes the picture wall.

decision_log.decision: Floor finish: engineered oak wide plank with matt hardwax oil.
decision_log.rationale: Warm, repairable and non-glossy; continuous across the vestibule so the threshold is marked by ceiling height, not by a floor change.

decision_log.decision: Wall finish: matt clay plaster on all plastered walls; no mirror panels and no gloss anywhere on a wall surface.
decision_log.rationale: Meets the brief's material prohibitions and gives soft, low-glare light next to a 3.90 m window band.

decision_log.decision: Underfloor heating assumed; no radiators under the window band.
decision_log.rationale: Allows the two-seat sofa to sit 0.20 m from the south wall, keeping the group compact and the north corridor wide.

decision_log.decision: Rug 2.40 x 2.50 m set under the front legs of the sofas and armchair.
decision_log.rationale: Binds the three separate seating pieces into one group and absorbs sound in a hard-floored room.
